career_ladder.salary_growth_trajectory: Direct recruitment as Sub-Inspector (SI) of Police (Civil / Executive) and Jamadar (Manipur Rifles / Armed Branch) through the Manipur Police Recruitment Board appoints officers to Manipur Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2019 Pay Matrix Level 6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400). Following completion of basic training at the Manipur Police Training College (MPTC), Pangei, officers serve as investigating and law enforcement heads at police stations. Progression follows through promotion to Inspector of Police / Subedar (Level 7 / Level 8), Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP / Assistant Commandant in the State Police Service, Level 10, ₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500), Additional Superintendent of Police (Addl. SP, Level 11, ₹67,700 – ₹2,08,700), and Superintendent of Police (SP / Battalion Commandant, Level 12 / Level 13, ₹78,800 – ₹2,09,200), with potential induction into the Indian Police Service (IPS).

official_perks.description: Dearness Allowance at 58% of Basic Pay (₹20,532 per month on entry basic of ₹35,400 as of 01.07.2025) as sanctioned by Finance Department, Government of Manipur.
HRA at 8% of Basic Pay (₹2,832 per month) for Imphal and district headquarters, or rent-free government police quarter accommodation.
Special police duty / hardship allowance of ₹3,000 per month admissible to operational and executive police officers.
Subsidized ration allowance and uniform maintenance allowance (approx ₹2,500 per month) as per Manipur Police regulations.
Medical allowance of ₹1,000 per month plus Chief Minister Gi Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT) / State Medical Attendance Reimbursement.
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Government matching contribution and police welfare fund benefits.
